drk.text: Urhaalan Valley is the home of the minotaurs, where Yunnie is accepted into the community and discovers a third party behind their war with the elves.
Sacumon tricks him into donning the cursed Living Armor and silences him, but Maeveen saves him and brings him back to the front.
Maeveen's group helps defeat Sacumon and end the war at great cost, as a giant statue of Tiyint they animate kills elves until Mytaru's misspoken command turns it on the minotaurs.
In the valley Yunnie is revealed to hold the sigil as the son of Peemel's fourth wife and Vervamon, who becomes a teacher for the Niroso.
